info.name: Leave Management API
info.description:
# Leave Management API

RESTful Leave Management API built using Laravel 12.

## Features

- Sanctum Authentication
    
- Google OAuth Login
    
- Leave Request Management
    
- Leave Approval Workflow
    
- Role-Based Authorization
    

## Authentication

Protected routes require:

``` http
Authorization: Bearer {token}

 ```

## Base URL

``` txt
http://localhost:8000

 ```

## Roles

### Admin

- approve leave
    
- reject leave
    
- view pending leaves
    

### Employee

- create leave request
    
- view leave history

# Register User

Create a new employee account.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
POST /api/auth/register

 ```

---

## Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json |

---

## Request Body

``` json
{
  "name": "Haikal",
  "email": "haikal@example.com",
  "password": "password",
  "password_confirmation": "password"
}

 ```

---

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rules |
| --- | --- |
| name | required, string |
| email | required, unique |
| password | required, confirmed |

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Register successful.",
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Haikal",
      "email": "haikal@example.com"
    },
    "token": "sanctum-token"
  }
}

 ```

---

## Notes

- Newly registered users are assigned the `employee` role by default.
    
- Authentication uses Laravel Sanctum.

# Login Employee

Authenticate employee account and return Sanctum access token.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
POST /api/auth/login

 ```

---

## Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json |

---

## Request Body

``` json
{
  "email": "employee@gmail.com",
  "password": "password"
}

 ```

---

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rules |
| --- | --- |
| email | required, email |
| password | required |

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Login successful.",
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": 2,
      "name": "Employee",
      "email": "employee@gmail.com",
      "role": "employee"
    },
    "token": "sanctum-token"
  }
}

 ```

---

## Notes

- Copy returned token into Postman collection variable:
    

``` txt
employee_token

 ```

- Use the token for all protected employee endpoints.
    
- Authentication uses Laravel Sanctum Bearer Token.

# Google OAuth Redirect

Generate Google OAuth authentication redirect URL.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
GET /api/auth/google/redirect

 ```

---

## Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json |

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Success",
  "data": {
    "redirect_url": "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth?..."
  }
}

 ```

---

## OAuth Flow

1. Send request to this endpoint.
    
2. Copy returned `redirect_url`.
    
3. Open the URL in browser.
    
4. Login using Google account.
    
5. Google redirects back to callback endpoint.
    
6. API returns authenticated user and Sanctum token.
    

---

## Notes

- OAuth authentication uses Laravel Socialite.
    
- If email already exists, the existing account will be linked with Google OAuth.
    
- OAuth users can authenticate using Google login flow.

# Google OAuth Callback

Handle Google OAuth callback after successful authentication.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
GET /api/auth/google/callback

 ```

---

## Description

This endpoint is automatically called by Google after successful OAuth authentication.

Users should not manually access this endpoint without a valid OAuth authorization code.

---

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| code | Google OAuth authorization code |

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "OAuth login successful.",
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "User",
      "email": "user@gmail.com"
    },
    "token": "sanctum-token"
  }
}

 ```

---

## Notes

- This endpoint is part of the Google OAuth flow.
    
- Automatically called by Google after user authentication.
    
- Accessing endpoint manually without `code` parameter will return OAuth error.

# Logout User

Logout authenticated user and revoke current Sanctum token.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
POST /api/auth/logout

 ```

---

## Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json |
| Authorization | Bearer {token} |

---

## Authentication

Requires authenticated user token.

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Logout successful."
}

 ```

---

## Notes

- Current access token will be revoked.
    
- User must login again to access protected endpoints.
    
- Works for both admin and employee accounts.

# Get Leave History

Retrieve authenticated employee leave request history.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
GET /api/employee/leaves

 ```

---

## Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json |
| Authorization | Bearer {employee_token} |

---

## Authentication

Requires authenticated employee token.

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "start_date": "2026-05-10",
      "end_date": "2026-05-12",
      "days": 3,
      "reason": "Family event",
      "status": "pending"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

---

## Notes

- Only authenticated employees can access this endpoint.
    
- Returns leave history ordered by latest request.

# Create Leave Request

Create a new leave request with attachment upload.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
POST /api/employee/leaves

 ```

---

## Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json |
| Authorization | Bearer {employee_token} |

---

## Authentication

Requires authenticated employee token.

---

## Body Type

``` txt
form-data

 ```

---

## Request Body

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| start_date | text | yes |
| end_date | text | yes |
| reason | text | yes |
| attachment | file | yes |

---

## Example Request

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| start_date | 2026-05-10 |
| end_date | 2026-05-12 |
| reason | Family event |
| attachment | leave-document.pdf |

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Leave request created successfully."
}

 ```

---

## Business Rules

- Leave dates must not overlap existing leave requests.
    
- Annual leave quota is enforced.
    
- Attachment upload is required.
    
- Newly created leave status defaults to `pending`.
    

---

## Notes

- File upload uses multipart/form-data.
    
- Supported file types:
    
    - pdf
        
    - jpg
        
    - jpeg
        
    - png
        
    - doc
        
    - docx

# Get Pending Leave Requests

Retrieve all pending leave requests.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
GET /api/admin/leaves/pending

 ```

---

## Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json |
| Authorization | Bearer {admin_token} |

---

## Authentication

Requires authenticated admin token.

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "user": {
        "id": 2,
        "name": "Employee"
      },
      "start_date": "2026-05-10",
      "end_date": "2026-05-12",
      "days": 3,
      "status": "pending"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

---

## Notes

- Only admin users can access this endpoint.
    
- Returns only leave requests with `pending` status.

# Approve Leave Request

Approve a pending leave request.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
PATCH /api/admin/leaves/{id}/approve

 ```

---

## Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json |
| Authorization | Bearer {admin_token} |

---

## Authentication

Requires authenticated admin token.

---

## URL Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| id | Leave request ID |

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Leave approved successfully."
}

 ```

---

## Business Rules

- Only leave requests with `pending` status can be approved.
    
- Approved leave stores:
    
    - approver admin
        
    - approval timestamp
        

---

## Notes

- Only admin users can approve leave requests.

# Reject Leave Request

Reject a pending leave request.

---

## Endpoint

``` http
PATCH /api/admin/leaves/{id}/reject

 ```

---

## Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json |
| Authorization | Bearer {admin_token} |

---

## Authentication

Requires authenticated admin token.

---

## URL Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| id | Leave request ID |

---

## Request Body

``` json
{
  "rejection_reason": "Insufficient team coverage"
}

 ```

---

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rules |
| --- | --- |
| rejection_reason | required, string |

---

## Success Response

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Leave rejected successfully."
}

 ```

---

## Business Rules

- Only leave requests with `pending` status can be rejected.
    
- Rejection reason is required.
    

---

## Notes

- Only admin users can reject leave requests.
